task.title: Housekeeping practical check: 7 real situations and an optional work photo
task.brief: This takes about 10 minutes. First answer 7 short questions. Each one describes a real housekeeping situation (a bathroom, a bed, a trolley, a wet floor) and asks which way is right and safe. Then, if you want, upload one photo of your own past work: a room you cleaned, a bed you made, or a neatly set trolley. You can also upload a housekeeping training or ITI certificate instead. Do not show any faces or guest belongings in the photo. The photo is optional, but a clear, genuine one helps employers trust your skill.
key_points: Picks the safe, hygienic choice in each situation
Keeps toilet tools apart from room tools
Photo shows real, neat housekeeping work

rubric.label: Relevance
rubric.guide: 0 = no photo or unrelated photo, 3 = housekeeping work but unclear, 5 = clear photo of cleaned room, made bed or set trolley

rubric.label: Genuineness
rubric.guide: 0 = looks copied from the internet, 3 = probably own work, 5 = clearly own work or a real certificate

rubric.label: Safety and hygiene
